latest_release.body:
[[简体中文]](https://sun-panel-doc.enianteam.com/zh_cn/update/update_log.html) | [English]

> [!CAUTION] 
> 
> 1. Before upgrading from the Docker version `v1.3.0` or earlier to this version, please read the [Update Instructions](https://github.com/hslr-s/sun-panel/discussions/98) first.
> 2. If you want to view the Docker status in the container, add the following when mounting: `-v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock` (Some devices may not support this.)
> 3. If any exception occurs after updating, please try to force refresh the page (ctrl+shift+R). If it cannot be solved, you can try clearing the browser cache (ctrl+shift+del).

- **Homepage Project Cards**
  - **[Added]** A loading bar at the top. Its loading state is tied to the data API, independent of whether cached data has finished loading. For example, when card caching is enabled, cards may finish loading from the cache while the loading bar is still active.
  - **[Added]** Icons for the card context menu.
  - **[Added]** A Restart Container action in the Docker card context menu.
  - **[Optimized]** Improved the overall loading speed of project cards and reduced API calls.
  - **[Optimized]** Significantly improved the status loading speed of Docker cards and reduced API calls.
  - **[Optimized]** More reasonable allocation of local cache space for project cards.
  - **[Fixed]** Severe page lag caused by too many Docker container cards.

- **Docker Manager**
  - **[Added]** A Refresh button.
  - **[Optimized]** Improved status loading speed.

- **OpenAPI**
  - **[Fixed]** An issue where updating only some parameters through `/item/update` could cause the original `iconUrl` parameter to be lost. Thanks to Bilibili user `AI老G` for reporting this.

- **Other**
  - Append `/clear` to the project URL to access local cache cleanup. After clearing the data, restart and sign in again. This is generally intended for use when encountering exceptions.

detail.readme:
发布程序的流程说明： 修改 `assets\version` 版本号。 ```sh # 提交代码，打标签 git tag v1.3.2-beta24-02-02 # 推送到 pro 远程库 git push pro --tag # 编译 # 有新标签docker版本会自动在 github action 编译 # 二进制版本，需要将代码推到主库，并且在虚拟机中找到项目目录和编译的镜像，并拉取标签，启动容器并进去拉取代码 # 虚拟机编译 git pull --tag # 注意切换到分支要编译的分支 chmod +x ./build && ./build -r # 编译成功后下载各种二进制文件上传到github ``` [[ 简体中文 ]](https://doc.sun-panel.top/zh_cn/) | [[ English ]](https://doc.sun-panel.top/)

![](./doc/images/main-dark.png) > [!IMPORTANT] > In order to maintain the livelihood, the author added some [`PRO`] (https://pro.sun-panel.top) function, so the project temporarily entered a closed source state.; At present, the latest version of the open source is `v1.3.0`, [Please see the latest version of closed source](https://github.com/hslr-s/sun-panel/releases).; When the modular technology is developed, the separation of the PRO and the programs will be opened again, and the closed source will have no effect on ordinary users.; Let's look forward to open source again, and at the same time, we are welcome to supervise and review the security of the program. > > 作者为了维持生计，增加了一些 [`PRO`](https://pro.sun-panel.top) 功能，所以项目暂时进入闭源状态。目前开源最新版本为`v1.3.0`，[闭源最新版本请查看](https://github.com/hslr-s/sun-panel/releases)。待开发出模块化技术，然后对PRO和主程序进行分离会再次开源，闭源对普通用户没有任何影响。我们一起期待再次开源吧，同时也欢迎各位大佬对程序的安全性进行监督和审查。 ## 😎 Features - 🍉 Clean interface, powerful functionality, low resource consumption - 🍊 Easy to use, visual operation, zero-code usage - 🍠 One-click switch between internal and external network modes - 🍵 Supports Docker deployment (compatible with Arm systems) - 🎪 Supports multi-account isolation - 🎏 Supports viewing system status - 🫙 Supports custom JS, CSS - 🍻 Simple usage without the need to connect to an external database - 🍾 Rich icon styles for free combination, supports [Iconify icon library](https://icon-sets.iconify.design/) - 🚁 Supports opening small windows in the webpage (some third-party websites may block this feature) ## 🖼️ Preview Screenshots **Various styles, freely combined** ![](./doc/images/icon-small-new.png) ![](./doc/images/transparent-info.png) ![](./doc/images/transparent-small.png) ![](./doc/images/solid-color-info.png) ![](./doc/images/full-color-small.jpg) **Built-in small windows** ![](./doc/images/window-ssh.png) ![](./doc/images/window-xunlei.png) ## 🐳 Deployment tutorial [Deployment Tutorial](https://sun-panel-doc.enianteam.com/usage/quick_deploy.html) ## 🍵 Donate > Open-source development is not easy. If you feel that my project has helped you, you are welcome to [donate](./doc/donate.md) or buy me a cup of tea☕ (please leave your nickname or name in the note if possible). Your support is my motivation, thank you. | | | | ------------ | ------------ | | | | ## 🏖️ Communication group & community Author：**[红烧猎人](https://blog.enianteam.com/u/sun/content/11)** [Github Discussions](https://github.com/hslr-s/sun-panel/discussions) QQ交流群，进不去可以点上方连接联系作者 ## ❤️ Thanks - [Roc](https://github.com/RocCheng) - [jackloves111](https://github.com/jackloves111) - [Rock.L](https://github.com/gitlyp) --- [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=hslr-s/sun-panel&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#hslr-s/sun-panel&Date)
